items.title: Albert Morgan Interview, 1958-08-19
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] All I knew was Jim Robinson later on in the last year. [INTERVIEWEE] No, no, no. Before Jim Robinson.

ctx.x: All I knew was Jim Robinson later on in the last year.
No, no, no. Before Jim Robinson. Hank is... Yank? Yank or Hank?
